answer_1.quote: For fidelity evaluation, we adopt not only traditional tasks, including PIQA (500, 10-shot) ... but also challenging multi-step reasoning tasks such as GSM8K (All, 8-shot) ... MATH (All, 4-shot) ... MBPP (200, 0-shot) ... HumanEval (All, 0-shot) ... and two additional chatbot datasets, namely ShareGPT (RyokoAI, 2021) and LMsys-1K.

answer_2.quote: We assess QSPEC with two primary criteria: (1) generation fidelity and (2) end-to-end serving speedup. For fidelity evaluation, we adopt not only traditional tasks, including PIQA (500, 10-shot) ... WikiText2 (Merity et al., 2016) ... GSM8K (All, 8-shot) ... MATH (All, 4-shot) ... MBPP (200, 0-shot) ... HumanEval (All, 0-shot).
